findings: recursiveDirectorySearch breadth-first queue capped by500 returned matches, not directories/entries/time. No visited/canonical-file set, depth guard, symlink rejection or cooperative cancellation inside helper. Symbolic-link cycle/no matches can keep traversal pending where filesystem permits; no live cycle or user-tree scan executed. Caller cancellation/dispatch/result publication still unread.

Directory listFiles exception/null skipped silently; no skipped count/error outcome/completeness flag returned. Search returns List<File> only, so inaccessible subtrees indistinguishable from no matches through this helper result. UI disclosure still unread.

Search matching trimmed lowercase name substring, not content. Includes directory matches and optionally dotnames; showHidden false only name.startsWith dot rather than other platform hidden attributes. Native filesystem listing order before limit makes subset nondeterministic across filesystem orders; no global top500 claim justified.

viewerImageCacheKey path/mtime/length/variant; no content identity/freshness proof for same-size preserved-mtime edits. File stats queried separately. Image request dimensions coerced>=1 with no explicit upper cap in helper; callsites pending.

decodeFastViewerPlaceholder target256..1200, platform ThumbnailUtils then bounds/sample fallback. Fallback bounds failures returnnull and sample loop reduces both dimensions against2xtarget; this differs original-size editor behavior. EXIF/orientation/actual codec parity untested.

Immersive window snapshot restores flags/barcolors/cutout but not backgrounds/dimAmount/contrast-enforced/previous decor-fits or bar behavior. Restore explicitly shows bars. Snapshot keepScreenOn field unused directly but savedflags includesbit; do not claim lostkeepScreenOn solely from unusedfield. Device visual/lifetime behavior unqualified.

Initial navigation category lists audio, while widget sends music. Later LaunchedEffect explicitly handles music and switchesAudio, so initial mismatch transient rather than missing music deeplink. Selected initial categories videos/archives/apks recognized in initializer but effect only internal/downloads/images/documents/music; later operations pending.

openMusicPlayerRequest effect runs parent directory listFiles/filter/sort and synchronous Manager.play without explicit IO context in shown block. Actual file readability only exists checked. Source path and media preparation costs unmeasured.

Most explorer state remember without file/navigation saveable keys; many DataStore flows collected with initial defaults. Lifecycle/persistence and deep-link races need remaining source. Album state/locking helper definitions unread; do not infer app-lock bypass.
